prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, and the kind of healthcare work you need (consumer patient acquisition vs. B2B/device marketing, brand + creative vs. strictly performance/SEO, HIPAA-compliant digital builds, etc.). I can, however, help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me give a tailored recommendation:

- What are your primary goals? (patient acquisition, physician referral growth, telehealth launch, employer health plan marketing, device or pharma marketing, brand awareness, etc.)
- Who’s your audience? (consumers/patients, clinicians, health systems, payers)
- Geographic scope: strictly St. Louis-area or national?
- Monthly/annual marketing budget range?
- Do you require HIPAA-compliant platforms, patient portal integration, or EMR/CRM work?
- Preferred agency size: boutique/local or national with local presence?

How to find and evaluate the best local agency (quick guide)
- Use directory filters: Clutch.co, UpCity, DesignRush — filter by location + healthcare/medical vertical and sort by reviews and case studies.
- Check local sources: St. Louis Business Journal agency lists, LinkedIn company pages, and Google Reviews.
- Look for specific healthcare experience: HIPAA/compliance, case studies with measurable outcomes (new patient volume, cost per acquisition, lead-to-appointment conversion).
- Ask for references and recent case studies with KPIs.
- Verify technical capability: SEO, paid search, programmatic, patient acquisition funnels, analytics/reporting, EMR/CRM integrations.
- Confirm security and compliance: HIPAA business associate agreements (BAAs), data handling and storage practices, and any security certifications.
- Evaluate culture/communication: regular reporting cadence, single point of contact, team structure.

Key interview questions to ask shortlisted agencies
- Have you worked with organizations like ours (size, service line, audience)? Can you show results?
- What KPIs would you recommend and how will you measure them?
- Can you sign a BAA and describe your data security practices?
- Who will be our day-to-day team and what’s their healthcare experience?
- What’s your onboarding process and expected time to launch?
- What are typical budgets and contract terms for similar engagements?

Ballpark pricing (very general)
- Small / tactical projects: $3k–$10k/month.
- Mid-size integrated programs: $10k–$50k/month.
- Large enterprise / national integrated services: $50k+/month.
(Actual costs vary widely by scope, media spend, and required compliance/tech integrations.)

If you’d like, tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll compile a tailored shortlist of St. Louis agencies (3–6) with pros/cons and suggested interview questions for each. Which direction would you like to go?
